chunks: The time of salat al-Jumu‘ah, on the day of al-Jumu‘ah, is the hour when the sun declines, and its time in travel and residence is one and the same, and it is of the restricted time. And salat al-‘Asr on the day of al-Jumu‘ah is in the time of the first prayer on the rest of the days.

key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first prayer, meaning the earlier noon prayer
key_terms.الْمُضَيَّقِ: a restricted or narrow fixed time
key_terms.تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declines from the zenith
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the prescribed time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When does salat al-Jumu‘ah begin, and is its time different for travelers and residents?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the time of salat al-Jumu‘ah begins when the sun passes the zenith. It also clarifies that this ruling is the same whether one is traveling or resident, and that salat al-‘Asr on Friday falls at the time corresponding to the earlier prayer on other days.
